RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

That number is a highly uncertain subjective judgment, not a measured probability. An all-women panel alone is not evidence of sex bias. You and the successful candidate are both women; nothing you describe establishes that sex influenced the choice.

Your longer experience and project leadership merit consideration, but a group-head role may weigh client relationships, business development and people management heavily. The announcement is not her full résumé.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your experience was assessed, and feedback against those criteria. Raise panel composition only if additional evidence connects it to unfair treatment—not simply because its members were women.
